title: Field-window actual-Q3 multiplication-word majorant
question: On a declared bounded field window, do the actual onsite, Q3-edge and spatial-bond potential differences admit a two-orientation entire multiplication-word envelope?
method: Retain the field variables in the exact shifted onsite, Q3-edge and spatial-bond potentials.
Derive the source coefficient tables and apply the field-window triangle bounds B_on, B_edge and B_bond.
Sum one onsite, three Q3 edges and six spatial bonds, then verify the length-n coefficient-word and factorial envelope.
Run independent SymPy and Fraction lanes on a rational field grid and compile Lean R222 for the exact fixture rates.
finding: The exact field-dependent source tables obey the declared bounds. For the registered fixture B_on=105/64, B_edge=577/224, B_bond=13/12, B(Q,S)=7109/448 and tB=7109/1344. The local length-n coefficient-word envelope is B(Q,S)^n and the factorial generating envelope is exp(tB); endpoint reversal has the same bound.
decision_reason: This extends EXP-001039 from a source-only slice to the actual field-dependent local polynomial coefficients on a declared finite field window. It deliberately leaves the window-removal and operator-history steps open.

adversarial_review.check: The estimate is uniform only for |field|<=Q and does not remove Q.
The l1 polynomial norm does not prove CCR domains, commutators or Duhamel convergence.
Ten is a local bounded-degree envelope, not spatial support growth or first-passage decay.
Absolute endpoint reversal is not an adjoint-history identity.
B(Q,S) grows cubically in Q, so a field-independent common-core estimate is not inferred.
R222 checks exact rational fixtures only.
No thermodynamic QFT dynamics, OS/KMS, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A result is claimed.

qft_interface.closed: A field-window coefficient-level entire envelope for actual local Q3 potential differences with endpoint reversal symmetry.
qft_interface.open: Energy/state-weighted window removal, operator histories, spatial first-passage, exhaustion, common alpha, KMS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: No heat_root_incidence or A1/R-192 TECT production owner is supplied.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing bounded-field coefficient checkpoint. It does not prove Q3 real-time dynamics, a thermodynamic QFT, common alpha, KMS, a GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, Pre-A, TECT production or a Clay result.
next_action: Use the explicit O(Q^3) dependence to test a radius-loss or energy/state-weighted replacement; only after Q is absorbed by a declared common-core topology can the all-bond first-passage gate be attempted.
